$comment: Contract for data/tables/properties.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js; applicability by build/src/registry.js.
title: Property registry
description: One row per measured property. A new property is a new row here plus its measurements: no code changes. Domain decides the drawer tab and coverage domain; Units lists the canonical units a usable measurement may carry; Applies to limits the property to some materials (blank: all).

fields.name: Property
fields.description: Property name, exactly as measurements.csv uses it.

fields.name: Units
fields.description: Canonical units a numeric measurement of this property may carry. Different entries are not interconvertible (J/m and kJ/m², Shore A and Shore D).

fields.name: Applies to
fields.description: Which materials the property applies to, as 'Field: value | value; Field: value' over Family, Base polymer, Modifier / filler, Role, Scope or H2C status. Blank: all materials. A measurement of a material outside it is a build error.

fields.name: Not applicable reason
fields.description: Why the property does not apply outside 'Applies to'; required when it is set.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: What the property measures, where that is not obvious from its name.
